templates.why_chosen: Sparse, icon-only figure (9 components, no fill colors): a thin dashed Client box sits opposite a heavier Edge box holding all three intelligence modules, split by a plain dashed-vs-solid legend for control versus content data.
templates.what_to_learn: Make the size imbalance do the argument for you: draw the thin client as a small box with only two items while every piece of intelligence piles into the edge/host box, and use icon line art with a single dashed-vs-solid legend instead of color when the point is thin-vs-capable, not many flow types.
